response.sql: WITH eligible_patients AS (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' INTERSECT SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-'), patient_averages AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_difference FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN eligible_patients AS e ON e.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS average_pt, AVG(avg_tat_difference) AS average_tat_minus_tat2 FROM patient_averages;
